7523-the-lady-of-the-decoration.title: The Lady Of The Decoration
7523-the-lady-of-the-decoration.creator: Frances Little
7523-the-lady-of-the-decoration.description: A book by Frances Little. But when death suddenly put an end to it all, God alone knows what a relief it was! And how curiously it has all turned out! First my taking the Kindergarten course just to please you, and to keep my mind off things that ought not to have been. Then my sudden release from bondage, and the dreadful manner of it, my awkward position, my dependence,--and in the midst of it all this sudden offer to go to Japan and teach in a Mission school!

arxiv-2103-08874.title: Visualizing Outliers in High Dimensional Functional Data for Task fMRI data exploration
arxiv-2103-08874.creator: Yasser Alemán-Gómez, Ana Arribas-Gil, Manuel Desco, Antonio Elías, Juan Romo
arxiv-2103-08874.description: Abstract Task-based functional magnetic resonance imaging (task fMRI) is a non-invasive technique that allows identifying brain regions whose activity changes when individuals are asked to perform a given task. This contributes to the understanding of how the human brain is organized in functionally distinct subdivisions.

arxiv-2308-07346.title: Py-Tetrad and RPy-Tetrad: A New Python Interface with R Support for Tetrad Causal Search \titletag
arxiv-2308-07346.creator: Joseph D. Ramsey, Bryan Andrews
arxiv-2308-07346.description: Abstract We give novel Python and R interfaces for the (Java) Tetrad project for causal modeling, search, and estimation. The Tetrad project is a mainstay in the literature, having been under consistent development for over 30 years. Some of its algorithms are now classics, like PC and FCI; others are recent developments.

arxiv-2311-08323.title: The taste of IPA : Towards open-vocabulary keyword spotting and forced alignment in any language
arxiv-2311-08323.creator: Jian Zhu Changbing Yang Farhan Samir Jahurul Islam
arxiv-2311-08323.description: Abstract In this project, we demonstrate that phoneme-based models for speech processing can achieve strong crosslinguistic generalizability to unseen languages. We curated the IpaPack , a massively multilingual speech corpora with phonemic transcriptions, encompassing 115 languages from diverse language families, selectively checked by linguists.

arxiv-2311-12438.title: Analysis of the public HARPS/ESO spectroscopic archive Thanks: Tables 1 and 4 are only available in electronic form at the CDS via anonymous ftp to cdsarc.u-strasbg.fr (130.79.128.5) or via http://cdsweb.u-strasbg.fr/cgi-bin/qcat?J/A+A/.
arxiv-2311-12438.creator: V. Perdelwitz, T. Trifonov, J. T. Teklu, K. R. Sreenivas, L. Tal-Or
arxiv-2311-12438.description: Abstract Context. Magnetic activity is currently the primary limiting factor in radial velocity (RV) exoplanet searches. Even inactive stars, such as the Sun, exhibit RV jitter of the order of a few m s -1 due to active regions on their surfaces.

arxiv-2409-10212.title: Kernel-Based Learning of Stable Nonlinear Systems
arxiv-2409-10212.creator: Matteo Scandella, Michelangelo Bin, Thomas Parisini
arxiv-2409-10212.description: Abstract Learning models of dynamical systems characterized by specific stability properties is of crucial importance in applications. Existing results mainly focus on linear systems or some limited classes of nonlinear systems and stability notions, and the general problem is still open. This article proposes a kernel-based nonlinear identification procedure to directly and systematically learn stable nonlinear discrete-time systems.

arxiv-2410-18427.title: Group actions and irrationality in surface families
arxiv-2410-18427.creator: Nathan Chen, Louis Esser
arxiv-2410-18427.description: Abstract . Rationality specializes in families of surfaces, even with mild singularities. In this paper, we study the analogous question for the degree of irrationality. We prove a specialization result when the degree of irrationality on the generic fiber arises from the quotient by a group action. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 14E05, 14L30 1.

arxiv-2412-09508.title: L 2 L^{2} -Betti numbers of branched covers of hyperbolic manifolds
arxiv-2412-09508.creator: Grigori Avramidi, Boris Okun, Kevin Schreve
arxiv-2412-09508.description: Abstract We show that Gromov–Thurston branched covers satisfy the Singer conjecture whenever the degree of the cover is not divisible by a finite set of primes determined by the base manifold and the branch locus. 1 Introduction The Singer conjecture predicts vanishing of L^{2} -Betti numbers of closed aspherical manifolds outside the middle dimension.

pmc-10752579.title: Aortic growth after arch reconstruction with patch augmentation: a 2-decade experience
pmc-10752579.creator: Dominic P Recco, Shannen B Kizilski, Reena M Ghosh, Breanna Piekarski, Ashwin Prakash, David M Hoganson
pmc-10752579.description: OBJECTIVESOptimal aortic sizing during aortic arch reconstruction remains unknown. Negative effects of arch under- or oversizing are well-published. We aimed to characterize longitudinal aortic growth after patch-augmented arch reconstruction to identify the initial reconstructed arch size that results in normal mid-term arch dimensions.METHODSSingle-centre, retrospective review of infants undergoing Damus-Kaye-Stansel (DKS) or non-DKS patch-augmented aortic arch reconstruction between 2000 and 2021.

pmc-11271109.title: Research on Drivers and Barriers to the Implementation of Cold Ironing Technology in Zero Emissions Port
pmc-11271109.creator: Son-Tung Le
pmc-11271109.description: Ports play an important role in connecting the domestic and global economies. Zero emissions port models are actively developed and frequently utilized to fulfill economic objectives while reducing environmental effect. The cold ironing system is one of technological methods assisting ports in transitioning to zero emissions port models.

pmc-11431011.title: Downregulation of RhoB Inhibits Cervical Cancer Progression and Enhances Cisplatin Sensitivity
pmc-11431011.creator: Weijiao Wang, Yubin Jia, Yuhuan Liu, Xiaofeng Lv, Lili Guo, Silu Meng, Changyu Wang, Stefania Bortoluzzi, Stefano Lonardi, Miguel A Ortega
pmc-11431011.description: RhoB, a member of the Rho GTPase family, has been implicated in the malignant progression of various cancer types. However, its role in cervical cancer (CC) remains unclear. Therefore, this study aims to elucidate the biological function of RhoB in CC and its relationship with cisplatin sensitivity.

pmc-11445908.title: Does green tea catechin enhance weight-loss effect of exercise training in overweight and obese individuals? a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized trials
pmc-11445908.creator: Farhad Gholami, Jose Antonio, Mohadeseh Iranpour, Jason Curtis, Flavia Pereira
pmc-11445908.description: BackgroundGreen tea (GT) is a common component of supplements known as fat burners. It has gained popularity as an ergogenic aid for weight reduction to assist with obesity management. This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to explore the effect of green tea ingestion coupled with exercise training (EX) on body composition and lipid profile in overweight and obese individuals.

pmc-11462495.title: Selective Separation of C8 Aromatics by an Interpenetrating Metal–Organic Framework Material
pmc-11462495.creator: Na Sun, Xue Zhou, Han Yu, Xiuwen Si, Fu Ding, Yaguang Sun, Michael J Zaworotko
pmc-11462495.description: O-xylene (OX) is an important chemical raw material, but it is often produced in mixtures with other C8 aromatics. Similar physicochemical properties of the C8 isomers make their separation and purification very difficult and energy intensive. There is an unmet need for an adsorbent that would be effective for the separation of OX from the other C8 isomers.

pmc-12363403.title: Quantitative Sensory Testing in an Observational Cohort of Adults With Chronic Low Back Pain
pmc-12363403.creator: Michael J. Schneider, Carol M. Greco, Amanda M. Acevedo, Kevin M. Bell, Jessa Darwin, Anthony Delitto, Nathan E. Dodds, John M. Jakicic, Gina P. McKernan, Charity G. Patterson, Paul A. Pilkonis, Sara R. Piva, Gwendolyn A. Sowa, Nam V. Vo, Lan Yu, Ajay D. Wasan
pmc-12363403.description: BackgroundQuantitative Sensory Testing (QST), also known as psychophysical testing, includes standardized methods for assessing humans' perceptions of different types of sensory stimuli and their associated pain thresholds. QST results can be used to estimate altered or atypical sensory processing and thus can be useful for determining pain mechanisms such as nociplastic or central nervous system‐mediated pain.

pmc-12505401.title: Taxonomy Portraits: Deciphering the Hierarchical Relationships of Medical Large Language Models
pmc-12505401.creator: Radha Nagarajan, Vanessa Klotzman, Midori Kondo, Sandip Godambe, Adam Gold, John Henderson, Steven Martel
pmc-12505401.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). BackgroundLarge language models (LLMs) continue to enjoy enterprise-wide adoption in health care while evolving in number, size, complexity, cost, and most importantly performance. Performance benchmarks play a critical role in their ranking across community leaderboards and subsequent adoption.ObjectiveGiven the small operating margins of health care organizations and growing interest in LLMs and conversational artificial intelligence (AI), there is an urgent need for objective approaches that can assist in identifying viable LLMs without compromising their performance.

pmc-12631555.title: Cognitive and affective psychoeducation for Long COVID: a randomized controlled trial
pmc-12631555.creator: Carmen Cabello Fernandez, Vincent Didone, Alexia Lesoinne, Hichem Slama, Patrick Fery, Anne-Françoise Rousseau, Michel Moutschen, Michel Moutschen, Michel Moutschen, Gilles Dupuis, Gaël Delrue, Valentine Demoulin, Julien Goin, Clara Della Libera, Fabienne Collette, Sylvie Willems
pmc-12631555.description: Long COVID is a complex condition characterized by persistent symptoms, including cognitive difficulties and fatigue, which significantly impact daily functioning. Although various intervention strategies inspired by approaches used in the rehabilitation of other neurological conditions have been developed to address these issues, evidence of their efficacy in Long COVID populations remains limited.

pmc-13348027.title: Gut Bacterial 20-Hydroxysteroid Dehydrogenases Modify Endogenous Glucocorticoids and Corticosteroid Drugs
pmc-13348027.creator: Sean Coyne, Robert Ghergurovich, Francis Sacco, Francesca Lombardi, Kailey Paar, Jackson DeMartino, Annick A. Kenfack, Tyler M. M. Stack

pmc-13609849.title: Gravity-Based vs. Pump-Assisted Irrigation in Unilateral Biportal Endoscopic Decompression for Lumbar Spinal Stenosis: Effects on Operative Efficiency, Clinical Outcomes, and Complications
pmc-13609849.creator: Uğur Özdemir, Abdülhalim Akar, Muhammed Fatih Serttaş, Ali Murat Başak, Tunahan Aka
pmc-13609849.description: Background and Objectives: Unilateral biportal endoscopic (UBE) decompression has become an increasingly popular minimally invasive technique for the treatment of lumbar spinal stenosis. Although irrigation management is a critical component of this procedure that may influence operative efficiency and irrigation-related complications, comparative evidence regarding irrigation systems remains limited.

pmc-13641126.title: STING expression in pituitary neuroendocrine tumour immune microenvironments
pmc-13641126.creator: Paul Benjamin Loughrey, Aoife McArdle, Amélie Viratham Pulsawatdi, Kris D McCombe, Christine Greene, Hannah James, Estelle G Healy, Fionn Corr, Ella Ross, Stephen Cooke, Steven J Hunter, Márta Korbonits, Stephanie G Craig, Jacqueline A James
pmc-13641126.description: The pituitary neuroendocrine tumour (PitNET) immune microenvironment (IME) has become a recent focus of research interest. Multiplex immunofluorescence combined with digital image analysis is a powerful technique to interrogate the IME. Processes such as DNA damage response and cellular senescence have been implicated in somatotroph tumour pathogenesis, and these have in turn been linked with immunological responses to neoplasia.
